problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945962/assets/0bfadc49b3d5d846641b78e07a6ec279b11da13e6f69dec3f1f054e03d5d3f6d.png)

The speed-time graph shown above represents the motion of a windsurfer. At what times is the windsurfer accelerating?
worked_solution:
The windsurfer is accelerating when their acceleration is positive. In a speed-time graph, the acceleration is given by the slope of the line. So, we need to find the times for which the slope is positive.

We see from the graph that the slope is positive from $t=0\,\text{s}$ to $t=3\,\text{s}$ and from $t=5\,\text{s}$ to $t=7\,\text{s}.$ Therefore, the motorcycle is windsurfer in this time interval.

Question 13

The speed-time graph shown above represents the motion of a windsurfer. At what times is the windsurfer accelerating?

a
From 3s to 5s and from 7s to 9s
b
From 7s to 9s
c
From 0s to 3s and from 7s to 9s
d
From 3s to 5s
e
From 0s to 3s and from 5s to 7s
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The windsurfer is accelerating when their acceleration is positive. In a speed-time graph, the acceleration is given by the slope of the line. So, we need to find the times for which the slope is positive.

We see from the graph that the slope is positive from t=0s to t=3s and from t=5s to t=7s. Therefore, the motorcycle is windsurfer in this time interval.
